# U3: Weekly review: walk the goals worst first, decide what happens next and record what was said

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `REVIEW`, `INSPECT-ACT`, `OUTCOME-TREE`, `ATTENTION`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `REVIEW-RUN`, `REVIEW-DECIDE`, `ONE-ASK`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Marisol, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U3

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Marisol runs the Reliability weekly, already under way this Thursday (nine goals reviewed). One ask model: a question she asks in it is an ask, open on the owner's Home and goal page until they answer it.
- Open a fresh browser as Marisol (`marisol`).
- _Note:_ The goals view opens on the trees: each top goal with its forecast, then what feeds it, worst first.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** The outcome card (`.outcome-card`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `cards >= 2 && await p.getByText(/Projected/).first().isVisible() && ['off', 'risk', 'stale'].includes(await firstRow.getAttribute('data-tone')) && (await firstRow.locator('.trow-why').innerText()).length > 15`, where `const cards = await p.locator('.outcome-card').count()`; `const firstRow = p.locator('.outcome').first().locator('.trow').first()`. Else it says: the tree does not lead with the worst goal and its reason.
- _Note:_ Reviews lists the sessions she's in, one under way first; the Reliability weekly picks up where it was left.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “goals to discuss” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Open “Reviews” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- _Note:_ On the Reviews page itself: Home's strip can link to the same review when its session is past (backlog T).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Reliability weekly” link in the list of reviews is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Reliability weekly” link in the list of reviews.
- **Check:** The review’s page shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- _Note:_ Home's ring, the Reviews list and the review's page say the same count before, during and after (backlog T).
- How many goals of a review are reviewed, as each place that shows it says it: Home's ring (its count and its label) when it is this review's, the Reviews list, and the review's own ring and line. Read in a second tab of the same browser, so the journey's own page stays where it is. Returns the problems (`reviewedEverywhere(p, 'reliability', 'Reliability weekly')`).
- **Step.** Press the “Continue review” button.
- _Note:_ The review walks the goal pages themselves, one at a time, with what to say at the bottom.
- **Check:** The reviewbar (`.reviewbar`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - **Check:** The decide (`.decide`) shows.
  - **Check:** (`attention`) the status on the goal’s summary bar is visible (else: a goal in the review has no status).
  - If `items < 2`:
    - **Check:** Checkpoint “item 01”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
  - _Note:_ A goal behind asks what happens next before it moves on (deep review P2): a next step with an owner and a date.
  - If `!asked && await askOwner.isVisible().catch(() => false)`:
    - _Note:_ Ask the owner in a composer that names the goal; an empty question is refused; saving stays on the goal.
    - **Step.** Press the “Ask” button in the quiet links in the decide (`.decide .quiet-links`).
    - **Check:** (`attention`) met when `((await p.getByRole('dialog').getAttribute('aria-label')) || '').includes(title)`, where `const title = (await p.locator('h1').first().innerText()).trim()`. Else it says: the composer does not name the goal.
    - Press the “Save question” button.
    - **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Write a few words” is visible (else: asking without a question is not caught).
    - **Step.** Type “Can this be back on plan before the next incident review?” into the field showing “What would it take”.
    - **Step.** Press the “Save question” button.
    - **Check:** The words “Can this be back on plan” in the said (`.said`) shows.
    - **Check:** (`finish`) met when `p.url() === here`, where `const here = p.url()`. Else it says: saving a question moved to another goal.
    - **Check:** Checkpoint “saved question”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
    - **Step.** Press the “Reviewed &” button in the decide (`.decide`).
  - Otherwise:
    - If `items === 2`:
      - **Step.** Press the “Add a note” button.
      - **Step.** Type “Agreed to pair SRE and Observability on the burn-rate alerts.” into the field showing “What the review said”.
      - **Step.** Press the “Save note” button.
      - **Check:** The words “Agreed to pair” in the said (`.said`) shows.
      - **Step.** Press the “Reviewed &” button in the decide (`.decide`).
    - Otherwise:
      - Press the “Reviewed &” button in the decide (`.decide`).
  - **Check:** (`attention`) met when `toasts <= 1`, where `const toasts = await p.locator('.toast').count()`. Else it says: {toasts} messages stacked up during the review.
  - **Check:** The address changes.
- _Note:_ The walk is the exceptions; goals on track with nothing flagged are acknowledged together (Senior UX review, 2 Nov).
- **Check:** “Nothing flagged” is shown (else: healthy goals are not grouped after the exceptions).
- _Note:_ Finishing is its own step, asked first, that marks them together (deep review T3).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `healthyN > 0 && items <= 10 && await ack.isVisible()`, where `let items = 0`; `const ack = p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Finish review' })`; `const healthyN = Number(((await p.locator('.healthy-group .block-title').innerText().catch(() => '')).match(/\d+/) || ['0'])[0])`. Else it says: expected the healthy goals as one acknowledgement, saw {healthyN} after walking 0.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “healthy group”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Finish review” button.
- **Check:** The “Finish Reliability weekly” dialog shows.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “finish question”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Finish the review” button in the “Finish Reliability weekly” dialog.
- **Check:** “What was said” is shown (else: the held review leads with its record).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `!disagree.length`, where `const disagree = await reviewedEverywhere(p, 'reliability', 'Reliability weekly')`. Else it says: the reviewed count differs between views: {disagree.join('; ')}.
- **Check:** “Can this be back on plan” is shown (else: what was said is kept on the review).
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Reviews” link is visible (else: no way on from the review record).
- _Note:_ The question is an ask: one record, open, for the goal's owner, raised in this session.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `calls.length === items + healthyN + 1 && !!q && q.status === 'open' && q.reviewId === 'reliability' && !!qLog`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `let items = 0`; `const healthyN = Number(((await p.locator('.healthy-group .block-title').innerText().catch(() => '')).match(/\d+/) || ['0'])[0])`; `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const before = new Set(s0.changes.map((c) => c.id))`; `const calls = s.changes.filter((c) => !before.has(c.id) && c.actorId === 'marisol' && c.entity === 'decision')`; `const q = (s.requests || []).find((r) => r.kind === 'question' && /back on plan before the next incident review/.test(r.ask))`; `const qLog = s.changes.find((c) => !before.has(c.id) && c.entity === 'request' && c.action === 'asked' && c.entityId === (q && q.id))`. Else it says: expected 0{healthyN} reviews and a note logged, and the question as an open ask, saw {calls.length}{q ? '' : ', no question'}.
- _Note:_ The owner sees the question under "For you" in Next steps and asks on the goal, and on Home; everyone else in the same list.
- Go to `/goals/{goalId}` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Can this be back on plan” is shown (else: the question is not on the goal for everyone).
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(v) => localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:platform-org', v)`, given `q.recipientId`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const q = (s.requests || []).find((r) => r.kind === 'question' && /back on plan before the next incident review/.test(r.ask))`.
- Go to `/goals/{goalId}` in the demo.
- **Check:** “by Marisol in Reliability weekly” is shown in the step row (`.step-row`) (else: the owner sees the question on the goal).
- **Check:** “For you” is shown (else: the question is not under For you for its owner).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Questions for you” is shown (else: the owner’s Home groups the question with the other questions).
- **Check:** “Can this be back on plan” is shown (else: the owner’s Home shows the question).
- Close this browser.
